tools.name: search_parliament
tools.description: Use this when you need to find a European Parliament dossier (legislative or non-legislative procedure), an MEP, a committee, a political group or an EP document by name, topic or reference, and you do not know its id yet. Returns up to 15 matching records with their ids and epvotes.com urls; pass an id to get_dossier or get_mep next. Matches words in titles and names (e.g. "digital euro", "Metsola", "ECON", "2023/0212(COD)"). Do not use it for votes of a day; use list_votes.

query.description: Words to match: a dossier title, procedure reference, MEP name, committee code or document number.

type.description: Limit the search to one kind of record.

tools.name: list_votes
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what the European Parliament voted on a sitting day, this week, between two dates or on a subject, e.g. "what did Parliament vote today" or "votes on Ukraine in October". Without arguments it returns the latest sitting day; with only a query it searches the last 92 days. Votes are grouped by agenda item; each item has its deciding (final) vote with result and totals and the ids of its other votes for get_vote. Lists at most 40 items.

from.description: Start of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD (with to).

to.description: End of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD (with from).

this_week.description: All votes of the current week.

query.description: Keep only agenda items whose topic, title or vote labels contain these words, e.g. "psychosocial".

tools.name: list_upcoming_votes
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what the European Parliament or a committee will vote on soon, e.g. "what is on the plenary agenda next week" or "which committee votes are planned on 11 November". Returns the plenary and committee votes from today for up to 14 days, soonest first, each with date, time (Brussels), body (PLEN or committee code), procedure reference, title, a state and an epvotes.com url. The state is "not held yet", "scheduled time passed, result not published" or "result published" (with the result). An agenda is a plan that can change until the day: a vote counts as held only when a result is stored. A vote today with no time stays "not held yet" for the whole day. Use list_votes for votes already held.

days.description: How many days from today to look ahead (default 14).

body.description: Keep only plenary votes or only committee votes (default all).

committee.description: Keep only the votes of one committee, e.g. "ENVI" (joint meetings with that committee are included).

tools.name: get_vote
tools.description: Use this when you need the result of one European Parliament roll-call vote: totals, the split by political group and by country, the dossier it belongs to, and optionally how individual MEPs voted. Takes a vote id from list_votes, get_dossier or get_mep (or an epvotes.com/votes/<id> url). Set members to a group (e.g. "EPP", "S&D") or a country code (e.g. "DE", "FRA") to list those MEPs' votes.

members.description: Optional: list individual MEP votes for one political group or one country. "all" lists every MEP.

tools.name: get_dossier
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one European Parliament dossier (procedure): what it is, its type, lead committee, rapporteurs, the steps so far in Parliament, its plenary votes, and the Legislative Observatory summary. Takes a procedure reference such as "2023/0212(COD)" or an id such as "2023-0212" (use search_parliament first if you only know the title).

votes_page.description: Page of plenary votes, 50 per page.

tools.name: get_mep
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one Member of the European Parliament: country, political group, committees, how often they vote with their group, where they broke with it, and their recent roll-call votes. Takes an MEP id or a name. Set topic to keep only votes whose label, agenda item topic or dossier title contains those words (e.g. "digital euro", "Mercosur"). Set from and to to read one period; page through all votes of the term with page.

mep.description: The MEP id (e.g. "124834") or name (e.g. "Martin Sonneborn").

topic.description: Optional: only votes whose label, agenda item topic or dossier title contains these words.

from.description: Optional: only votes on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: Optional: only votes on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

page.description: Page of votes, 25 per page, newest first (400 pages reach 10,000 votes; use from and to for older votes of a busy term).

tools.name: compare_groups
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to compare how two or three European Parliament political groups voted across recent final votes on texts (amendments left out), e.g. "how often did EPP and S&D vote the same way". Groups: The Left, S&D, Greens/EFA, Renew, EPP, ECR, PfE, ESN.

groups.description: Two or three group names, e.g. ["EPP", "S&D"].
